Welcome to **ARCL305: Archaeological Interpretation**.

This course examines how archaeologists construct, evaluate, and revise interpretations of the human past. Throughout the course, we focus on the relationship between archaeological evidence, theory, reasoning, and explanation.

::: {.callout-note title="A recurring question"}
**What is the claim → what evidence supports it → what assumptions connect evidence to interpretation → what alternative interpretation might also account for the evidence?**
:::
